name: Artery Hallways & the Knee Bends
body: Both wings connect to the pelvic floor through artery hallways that curve with the muscular geometry of the thighs. Unlike Ghost Haven's straight-shot arteries, Specter Haven's hallways bend — creating alcoves and blind corners that brats exploit for ambushes and tops exploit for pinning. The knee bends have witnessed more surprise encounters than any other architectural feature in either house, and the family has stopped pretending they were not designed for exactly this.
